notes: Job Agent 3.2.0 Beta improves recommendation quality based on the real 3.1.1 macOS search log. For equally rated REVIEW vacancies, list and manual-review suggestions now favor verified evidence, fewer mandatory experience constraints, fewer blockers, and stronger confirmed skill fit, without altering APPLY or REVIEW thresholds. Prague-only mode now identifies Jihlava/Vysočina as outside the target area, while fully remote opportunities remain eligible. Contract labels such as Full-time/Part-time are rejected as employer names in both browser and JSON-LD extraction. Six additional offline regression cases bring CI coverage to 214 tests. Existing Fit Intelligence, the fixed release source module integrity check, human final Submit and confirmed-only submission history remain unchanged.
